narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Odd is the key word, so the odd numbered lockers stay open.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Locker three has only two factors, one and three, so it is opened and then closed.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The count of factors must be odd, not the locker number.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows the odd numbered lockers stay open; locker 3 lights with people 1 and 3 above it; its door opens then closes; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>An odd count of factors means a square, and a square locker stays open.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A school has thirty lockers and thirty people play the same game. Which lockers stay open?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line open means an odd count of factors, so a square appears; then a new line 30 lockers, which stay open? appears with an empty box
